prompt: Create an accessible inline SVG icon for a close button that can inherit CSS color.
expected: Inline SVG with viewBox, role=img, first-child title, currentColor styling, and no hard-coded black fill on the glyph.
actual: Produced: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" role="img"><title>Close</title><path d="M18 6L6 18M6 6l12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>. Matched expected a11y + theming shape; validator clean on package.
